comments.text: What you shared is only half related to senior citizens. Even though you are suggesting to choose Elevate Jumpstart and similar add-ons for All insurance policies that's only half they offer those waiting period from 3 year --> 30 days only for BP, Diabetes, Ashtma, Cholestrol mostly and if there are any other diseases then we need to buy another add-ons if available which will bring the waiting period to at minimum of 1 year and as mentioned in the video for specific illnesses like Joint Replacment, Cataract yes the waiting period is same 24 months amongst all insurance providers and most don't have any option to bring them down to 1 year. And regarding ICICI elevate I have checked the Claim Payout ratio as well according to the 2022-2023 data which is the latest available as 2024-2025 has not been published yet, from that What I found was all these companies only pay upto maximum 71% of claimed amount and of this hdfc ergo is the one on top and Aditya Birla is also more or less the same. ICICI is very strict with around 65%. And I also heard ICICI is found more rejecting in the claim front than HDFC ergo. And many people reported the companies to increase the premium at renewal by nearly 100% but I think IRDAI brought new rule to cap it at 10% but still companies can discountinue the existing policy and ask us to buy new one on higher premium. And during my analysis I found almost all companies are focused on rejecting our claims based on non-disclosure as said in this video we have to disclose every health condition even 10-15 years back also. And second thing they decrease the amount example: if hospital charges 25,000/day for ICU then if the health insurance has set the amount to be just 15,000/day for ICU then they won't give entire 25,000. This is just for example real prices would be very different. So what we can do is at most be prepared to pay atleast 35% of our costs and expect the insurer to pay the remaining 65% keeping our expectations low. And yes I do find Care, Niva Bupa complaints increased quite a bit and HDFC has lower number of unsatisfied people. I have looked it on reddit, quora and Google everywhere people left reviews. Even hdfc offers ABCD add-on to reduce diabetes, bp waiting period to 30 days but still has 24 month waiting period for specific illness while icici reduces everything to 1 year will bp diabetes to just 30 days but we have to select all available waiting period add-ons to get this which costs too high. So study more and choose your prefernce. Disclose everything and be prepared to pay 35% of bill from your pocket
